articleTitle: Research on Active Equalization Layered Control Strategy for Series Connected Lithium-ion Battery Pack
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: This paper proposes and analyzes an equalization strategy based on the active equalization layered control of series Li-ion battery packs while using inconsistent battery charge states, and it employs a Buck-Boost based equalization circuit structure for the layered control of series battery packs. Inner layer control and outer layer control are the two types of layered control. Inner layer control enables energy transfer between adjacent single cells, and outer layer control enables for energy transfer between adjacent battery packs. Both layers of control can be performed simultaneously to increase the equalization speed of series battery packs. By building an experimental platform, improved two better equalization strategies are presented to execute static, charging, and discharging equalization tests on a four-cell series Li-ion battery pack, and the feasibility of the equalization scheme is verified.

articleTitle: Design of Multimode In-Memory Computing Architecture Based on SRAM
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: With the increasing number of usage scenarios for data-intensive applications, the bottleneck of traditional von-Neumann computing architecture is becoming increasingly apparent, with a large amount of data handling bringing more power consumption and latency. In-memory computing is the embedding of computing units into storage units for data reading and calculation operations, reducing data handling and storage back operations, and reducing power consumption. This article proposes an In-memory computing circuit model based on 9T SRAM, which separates read and write ports to make data more stable. Multiple working modes can also be achieved in SRAM, such as direct calculation of internal and external data in storage units. Finally, simulation was conducted based on the SMIC 0.18um CMOS process. The results indicate that in memory computing with multiple working modes has significant advantages.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Method for Array Antenna Pattern Synthesis Based on Genetic Algorithm and Adjacent Array Elements Constraints
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: An innovative methodology based on genetic algorithms for array antenna pattern optimization is proposed. The methodology contains two steps: Firstly, two adjacent array elements are bonded by assuming them with identical feeding information, which means the unknown parameters of the antenna array are reduced into half. Then, a genetic algorithm is implemented to get a set of optimization parameters. Secondly, based on the parameters obtained above, the feeding information of the adjacent array elements are unbundled, and then the previous parameters are optimized in a small range with a genetic algorithm to obtain the final optimization. Numerical simulation indicates this method is suitable for large antenna array optimization, capable of effectively achieving better radiation results.

articleTitle: Application Research of Collaborative Filtering Algorithm in Catering Recommendation System
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: Collaborative filtering algorithm is commonly used in recommendation systems. Based on the traditional collaborative filtering algorithm, this paper proposes an improvement scheme. When calculating similarity, an improved cosine similarity formula is first used, followed by adding time threshold parameters for weighting. Furthermore, the similarity results are re-weighted based on the number of common scoring items among users, and finally normalized.

articleTitle: Design of Digital Up-conversion Based on Inverse-sinc Compensation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: In digital up-conversion (DUC) systems, the ringing effect that occurs in the high-frequency band of the Cascade integral Comb (CIC) module and the inherent fading in the amplitude-to-frequency characteristics of the digital-to-analog converter (DAC) module lead to a high error rate during signal transmission. In this paper, we address this problem by improving the CIC filter module and DAC module using a combination of Inverse-sinc based digital compensation algorithm and optimized hardware structure. In the algorithm, a digital compensation algorithm based on Inverse-sinc algorithm is proposed to solve the amplitude distortion problem of the two modules by the method of inverse compensation, which reduces the dynamic error. For hardware design, a symmetric parallel structure is used to design the DAC module, which reduces the consumption of multiplier resources by 50%. Finally, through verification platform testing and comparative experimental analysis, the optimized scheme has an in-band flatness of basically 0, which improves the overall system computing speed while reducing hardware resource consumption.

articleTitle: A Study on the Use of Machine Learning for Detecting Abnormalities in Gas Pressure Regulator
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: By the end of 2021, the average penetration rate of gas(LNG:Liquefied Natural Gas) nationwide reached 85% in Korea. Being extensively utilized in various fields including households and industries, ensuring a consistent supply of gas is crucial. Additionally, detecting pressure anomalies is important as it allows for timely adjustments when required. This paper presents a model for anomaly detection in the secondary pressure of gas regulators located in the Gyeryong city Korea.In addition, weather data that may affect the gas pressure was collected, and the analysis was carried out considering temperature and wind speed. Given the interconnected nature of most gas regulators, this study models four adjacent gas regulators in Gyeryong city simultaneously to identify abnormal pressure values. The models used in this analysis are VAR, a traditional multivariate time series model, Long Short-Term Memory Auto Encoder (LSTM-AE), a machine learning technique for time series anomaly detection, and Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection via Graph Attention Network (MTAD-GAT), which directly incorporates variable correlations into the model.The study develops proper models that analyzes four gas regulators in Gyeryong City using three algorithms to identify abnormal pressure points. The performance evaluation of each model utilized an F1 score, and the MTAD-GAT model demonstrated the highest F1 score. Furthermore, the model not only identifies abnormal values at a specific time but also considers the value immediately preceding the anomaly. When implemented on-site, this model will be able to enhance the efficiency of anomaly detection.

Author Keywords: Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection via Graph Attention Network (MTAD-GAT)

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Ti3C2TX MXene Based Multi Band Transparent Antenna for Wireless Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: The proposed nonmetallic material based $\mathrm{T}\mathrm{i}_{3}\mathrm{C}_{2}\mathrm{T}_{\mathrm{X}}$ MXene antenna is printed on transparent PET substrate. The transparent antenna can be installed in scenarios where the concealment of the antenna and the overall industrial design of the product have higher requirements. The antenna uses a symmetrical T-slot with defective ground design to achieve a multi-band design and the antenna shows excellent efficiency in multiple target frequency bands. The excellent performance and transparent compact structure of the antenna is the first choice for system miniaturization, the antenna works in three frequency bands 5.70-6.27GHz, 9.13-9.48GHz, 10.77GHz-12.71GHz, with the lowest S-parameter to −42.7dB. The designed antenna has good radiation performance, high isolation and compact structure and lighter weight in operating band, especially in high frequency with 1.91G impedance bandwidth, which can be used for wifi6E and fixed satellite communication service. The simulation results show the great potential of MXene materials as RF devices.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Situation Awareness Based on Improved STFrFT
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: How to effectively perceive the distribution of electromagnetic radar radiation sources on the battlefield is of great practical significance for radar jamming systems. To this end, a radar emitter signal type classification technology based on improved Short-term Fractional Fourier Transform is studied. Firstly, establish a multifunctional radar complex modulation signal model. Time frequency structural model. Secondly, an improved STFrFT method is adopted, considered with the comprehensive consideration of the restricts of traditional TFT (time frequency transform) kernel functions, parameters of signal types, Cross-terms of multi-component signals, and distorted signal characteristics. Simulation experiments have shown that the recognition performance of radar complex modulation types with lower signal-to-jam ratio (SJR) using the proposed method is superior to conventional time-frequency analysis methods, verifying the technical rationality of the proposed technique.

articleTitle: Variable Momentum Constant Modulus Algorithm for Blind Equalization of CPFSK Signals
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: In order to improve the convergence speed of the constant modulus algorithm (CMA) for continuous phase frequency shift keying (CPFSK) signal blind equalization under certain steady-state error conditions, a variable momentum CMA (VMCMA) for blind equalization of CPFSK signals is proposed in this paper. The momentum CMA (MCMA) for blind equalization of CPFSK signals is obtained by introducing the momentum algorithm and adding the momentum term in the update iteration process to improve the convergence speed of the blind equalization algorithm. The effect of the momentum factor on the convergence performance of the algorithm is investigated, and the momentum term is improved by introducing a variation factor to reduce the steady-state error after convergence of the MCMA, which leads to a VMCMA for blind equalization of CPFSK signals. The proposed VMCMA for blind equalization of CPFSK signals is experimentally compared with the CMA. Simulation results show that the VMCMA converges to the steady state faster than the CMA under the condition that the steady-state error after convergence of the algorithm is similar to that of the CMA.

articleTitle: Characterization of SBS Gain Spectrum Lineshape in Fiber
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: Stimulated Brillouin effect is a very important nonlinear effect of optical fiber. The linear characteristic of stimulated Brillouin gain spectrum is very important for applications in spectral analysis, microwave photonics, optical fiber sensing and other fields. Aiming at the linear characteristic of gain spectrum, it is difficult to obtain the gain spectrum data with high signal-to-noise ratio by using the existing methods. A gain spectrum measurement method using two narrow linewidth lasers is introduced. One laser is used as probe signal and the other tunable laser is used as pump signal to push-scan in wide band. The stimulated Brillouin gain spectrum measurement with high signal-to-noise ratio is realized by virtue of the single spectral line characteristic of high signal-to-noise ratio and the polarization following characteristic. The influence of different pump powers on the stimulated Brillouin gain characteristics such as spectral pattern and linewidth is measured and analyzed. Especially, the evolution of the gain spectral pattern from Lorentz line type to Gaussian line type is measured by direct experiment. The influence of pump power on the stimulated Brillouin gain level is revealed. It is found that when the pump power exceeds 15dBm, the gain spectrum appears saturation effect, and the linewidth of the measured gain spectrum begins to widen with the increase of the pump power. It is difficult to directly measure the Gaussian gain spectrum at high pump power. The effective convolution information between the stimulated Brillouin gain spectrum and the spectrum of the signal to be measured is obtained by the normalization and equal correction processing, so that the approximate Gaussian gain spectrum is obtained. Aiming at the problem that the gain spectral pattern in the middle gain region is complex and lacks a suitable mathematical model for the evolution of the gain spectral pattern, a spectral pattern model based on k-th Lorentz function fitting is proposed to describe the complete evolution process from Lorentzian to Gaussian. The experimental results show that it is an effective mathematical model of stimulated Brillouin gain spectrum. It can completely describe the linearity of stimulated Brillouin gain spectrum at different gains. Finally, the application of stimulated Brillouin effect in spectral analysis is explored. By selecting the pump power reasonably, the spectral splitting effect is the best when the gain spectrum is Gaussian, and the spectrum of 6314CA stabilized light source with 0.2pm resolution is obtained. the optical fiber stimulated Brillouin effect is shown to have great technical advantages in the field of ultrahigh-resolution spectral analysis, This is critical for the validation evaluation of the next generation of optical networks.

articleTitle: The Omni-directional Vision System for A Soccer Playing Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: An Omni-directional Vision System that uses a CMOS camera for an autonomous soccer playing robot is developed and tested. The detailed design of the vision system is described, including the hardware and software design. The experimental results showed that the robot is able to locate the ball in any direction around the robot, accomplishing our goal of having a functional omnidirectional vision system.

articleTitle: Solving the Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Window based on Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: This paper presents an end-to-end AC-D model for addressing the Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Windows (VRPTW) using reinforcement learning techniques. The proposed model employs a parameterized stochastic policy, which is trained through the observation of reward feedback and adherence to constraint rules. It then samples problem instances from a given distribution and identifies an approximately optimal solution. The model’s parameters are optimized using the policy gradient algorithm. Once trained, the model generates a sequence of continuous actions as solutions.The proposed model is built upon the Actor-Critic architecture and incorporates an encoder and decoder. Through dynamic interaction with the environment, it generates a set of sequences that satisfy the required constraints. By effectively minimizing the cost of all paths associated with the VRPTW, the model demonstrates its capability to optimize the overall routing efficiency.

articleTitle: The Rotor Position Study of Brushless DC Motors Without Position Sensors
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: The control system for a brushless DC motor (BLDC) without position sensors, for the zero or low-speed state, it is difficult to identify the initial rotor position of the motor due to the lack of induced electromotive force or ineffective recognition of it. To address this issue, a high-frequency pulse injection method based on the two-phase rotating coordinate system is proposed. In the zero-speed state of a brushless DC motor, by modulating the d-axis voltage at high frequency in the two-phase rotating coordinate system, real-time current acquisition is performed using an analog-to-digital converter (ADC) and the high-frequency estimator is used to obtain the initial rotor position of the motor. At low speeds, the ADC acquires highfrequency response signals, and the observer estimates the actual rotor position based on the acquired signals. This article mainly studies the high-frequency pulse injection of the d-axis in the two-phase rotating coordinate system. By acquiring the threephase high-frequency response currents, the signal is decoupled to obtain the initial rotor position and the rotor position during motor operation. The motor vector control is used to achieve smooth motor operation. Through MATLAB software simulation and experimental results verification, this method can improve the accuracy of rotor position estimation, enabling the motor to operate smoothly during operation, satisfying the motor’s requirement for the initial rotor position, and realizing the real-time acquisition of rotor position. The motor can operate smoothly at its lowest speed.

articleTitle: OAM Beam Tilt Angle Detection Based on Uniform Circular Antenna Array
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: In the field of wireless communication, the reception and detection of vortex electromagnetic wave is undoubtedly the key to the use of orbital angular momentum (OAM) for communication. However, the misalignment between transceivers seriously affects the accuracy of receiver mode detection. We model the misalignment and generate phase distribution data using a uniform circular antenna array (UCAA) as the transceiver antenna. A lightweight neural network MobileNetV2 is used to build a training model to study the mapping between the OAM phase information and the inclination angle, and the inclination angle between the planes where the transceiver antenna is located is detected. The accuracy of the inclination detection model is good, reaching 0.91.

articleTitle: An Adjustable Improved Window for FIR Filter Design
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: The window function has a wide range of applications in filter design, signal truncation, information processing, etc., especially in the design of filter using the window function method, the different window functions directly affect the performance and application of the filter, so how to improve the construction of a new window function is of great significance and value for the design of an excellent filter meeting the requirements of use. Based on Blackman window, Kaiser window and its parameters, Chebyshev window, this paper gets an improved adjustable window by multiplying the above Windows and raising them to the power of r. The shape of the window in time domain and frequency domain can change with the change of the adjusting parameter r. By comparing the improved window with common window functions such as Hanning window, Blackman window and so on in image and performance parameters (ripple ratio, main lobe width, etc.), the results show that the improved window has excellent ripple ratio and better roll down ratio when the main lobe width is very close to the general window function. The simulation results show that the filter with improved window design has better passband fluctuation and stopband attenuation, and the improved window is suitable for the cases with high requirements for sidelobe, especially the first side lobe.

articleTitle: AOA - redundant INS integrated navigation algorithm based on federated Kalman filter
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: For 5G communication, the angle of arrival (AOA) positioning has low success rate and low accuracy caused by base station shortage, put forward a combination positioning solution for AOA positioning technology and redundant inertial navigation systems (INS). And adopt a fusion resettlement federal Kalman filtering, which ameliorates the problem of decreased accuracy of INS for a long-term positioning and solving accuracy due to low accuracy and random errors. Simulations show that redundant INS/AOA combined navigation effectively improves the problem of positioning loss caused by 5G signal interruption and the problem of filtering divergence caused by long-term solution of inertial navigation system. This combination of positioning accuracy and reliability improved over single 5G positioning or INS positioning greatly. The use of fusion reset Federal Kalman can effectively detect system faults and isolate them, improving filtering accuracy and system reliability.

articleTitle: Multi-Stage Marine Ship Recognition Based on Stackable Residual Network
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: Marine ship recognition has always been an important research field. The ships can be usually recognized by analyzing their attribute characteristics. However, in the actual process of recognition, many ship recognition methods using a single model cannot meet the requirements of this task due to the complexity of ship types, diversity of interference factors and different information obtained from distance differences. Therefore, we propose a multi-stage ship recognition scheme. First, the single radiation emitter feature recognition network model is designed for long-distance recognition. Second, the fusion feature network model for short distance recognition. The proposed network is mainly constructed with the residual units, which not only simplify the training of deep networks and facilitate the spread of information, but also can solve the vanishing gradient and exploding gradient problem. The simulation experimental results show that the proposed network model has better performance than typical methods and has great potential in applications.

articleTitle: A 5G Dual Polarized High Gain Directional Antenna with Miniaturization
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: The continuous development of modern mobile communication, radar and electronic countermeasure system has driven communication equipment towards miniaturization and multi-functionalization, so the communication system has higher requirements on the operating bandwidth characteristics, radiation characteristics, and volume size of antenna and array antenna. A 5G dual-polarized high gain small directional radiating Sub-6GHz antenna is proposed. The designed antenna consists of a coplanar waveguide feed, a dual element butterfly radiating patch, and a parasitic rectangular strip around the patch. The parasitic strip is used to increase the bandwidth of the antenna and also used to improve the directional characteristics of the antenna. It is verified by HFSS simulation that the antenna has a directional antenna with wide bandwidth and good directional radiation pattern, which is suitable for micro-deformation monitoring radar applications.

articleTitle: Research on Effective Segment Extraction of Ship Surveillance Videos
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: Effective segment extraction has broad application prospects in the field of video surveillance. In action recognition or object recognition, a large number of repetitive background segments will reduce the efficiency of computation. This causes the algorithm to consume more time. Effective segments can greatly save computing and storage resources for both target detection and storage. Common algorithms are to process the whole surveillance video, such as frame difference method and optical flow method. However, false detection can occur when the picture is disturbed, such as snowflakes. Will result in low accuracy. The effective segment detection method adopted in this paper. First convert the color space. The surveillance video is then segmented. Features were extracted and repeated segments filtering was carried out to reduce the interference of bad images. Finally, effective segments are extracted. Experimental results show that the accuracy of the effective segment detection method adopted in this paper is increased by more than 50%, and the F-metric value is increased by more than 24%.

articleTitle: Micro-expression Recognition Based on Apex Frame Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: Emotions reflect human’s inner feelings. The precise recognition of emotions is the key to social communication and human-computer interaction. Micro-expression (ME) cannot be completely suppressed, and it can reveal human’s real emotional state. Therefore, it is an important cue for emotion recognition. However, due to the rapid and subtle nature of ME, extracting efficient features from ME sequences is tricky. ME recognition is still a challenging problem. Recently, deep learning based methods have been proposed in the field of pattern recognition and have achieved promising recognition performance. In this paper, we propose a ME recognition method based on apex frame using deep learning models to extract deep features and perform recognition. Firstly, we introduce deep learning based face detection model, named RetinaFace, to perform face detection and pre-processing operations on apex frames. Secondly, due to the limited availability and imbalance of ME data, we propose to use Deep Convolutional Neural Networks (DCNNs) and transfer learning for ME features extraction and recognition. By introducing a DCNNs based face recognition model called FaceNet, this study transfer the prior and learned knowledge in the field of face recognition to the field of ME recognition, thus reducing the training process and improving the performance of ME recognition. Experiments conducted on CASME II prove that our proposed framework is feasible and achieves good recognition performance. Furthermore, we investigate the impact of the number of apex frames on ME recognition, providing clues to address the problem of limited samples in deep learning-based ME recognition. Our work complements deep learning-based methods for emotion recognition and ME recognition, and demonstrates the powerful capabilities and promising potentialities of deep learning frameworks in ME recognition.

articleTitle: Design of Structured Query Language Online Judge Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: The research described in this paper aims to implement a novel SQL query evaluation system, known as the SQL Online Judge (SQLOJ), and conduct mining and analysis on the relevant data obtained from SQLOJ. This system is intended to provide guidance and inspiration for student learning, teacher instruction, and course design. The paper focuses on introducing the technologies and system framework utilized by the system, and proposes a system availability tradeoff strategy to address the issue of excessive concurrent online users. The research results presented in this paper establish SQLOJ as a comprehensive platform and data resource for practical teaching in database courses, offering an innovative foundation that effectively complements traditional approaches to professional and course descriptions.

articleTitle: Glare sign recognition based on improved Yolox algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: Traffic sign recognition is one of the most critical aspects of autonomous driving. To improve detection accuracy without increasing the number of model parameters too much, this paper uses Conditionally Parameterized Convolutions (condconv) to replace the convolutional blocks in Yolox-s. To understand the transfer of feature maps within the deep learning network, a gradient mapping using Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad-CAM) is used to generate a heat map. As the existing traffic sign dataset does not include data for glare situations, data augmentation was used to simulate traffic signs in a glare context. Experiments show that the proposed improvements can improve detection accuracy (+2.3%) with only a small increase in model parameters $(+0.1 \mathrm{M})$. The effectiveness of the proposed data augmentation method is demonstrated by using the trained model for real-world detection.

articleTitle: Transmission line inspection models improved by synthetic data from diffusion models
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: The training of deep learning models is inseparable from sufficient data as the driving force. However, in the power transmission model training task, it is very difficult and expensive to obtain sufficient training samples, so data augmentation has become a common means of increasing training samples. In recent years, various deep generative models have demonstrated strong sample generation capabilities in different modalities, especially generative adversarial networks (GANs) have made important progress in synthesizing compelling image and audio samples. However, the traditional GAN model faces difficulties in the large amount of data and computing resources required for training in the field of transmission lines, and there may be problems such as lack of diversity and detail in generated images, and unstable training. In order to solve these problems, this paper proposes to use a diffusion model-based method to generate transmission line images, expand the data set and improve model performance. The final transmission image generated by the model is complete and clear, and the overall model performance is improved by 1.5%.

articleTitle: MGRE: A Multi-Granularity Representation Enhancement Method in Multiple-Choice Question Answering
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: Multiple-choice question answering(MCQA) is one of the most challenging tasks in machine reading comprehension. MCQA task requires selecting the most appropriate answer from several relevant options for a given question. In recent years, many works have concentrated on designing models from the perspective of using the information of the question and options at a large granularity level. However, few studies have explored how the model uses the information to find the correct answer at a fine granularity level or a multi-granularity level. This paper proposed a multi-granularity representation enhancement method to use information from different granularities. The method introduces large-grained candidate option information into the question to guide the selection of fine-grained critical information and facilitate the information interaction between the answer and the question which is in line with the human reasoning processes. Experimental results show that the method proposed in this paper can effectively improve the accuracy of MCQA tasks without introducing external knowledge.

articleTitle: Indoor-Outdoor Scene Recognition Method based on Adaboost-PNN
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: In response to the challenges of low accuracy and instability in indoor-outdoor seamless positioning technology for scene recognition, this paper proposes a high-precision indoor-outdoor scene recognition method based on an adaptive boosting algorithm (Adaboost-PNN). The method utilizes the built-in magnetic sensor, Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) module, and WiFi module of a smartphone to collect training data. Based on the different features exhibited by the number of satellites, signal-to-noise ratio, geomagnetic intensity, and WiFi signal strength in indoor and outdoor environments, the data features are input into the adaptive boosting algorithm to train the indoor-outdoor scene recognition model. Comprehensive testing results demonstrate that the indoor-outdoor scene recognition model based on the adaptive boosting algorithm achieves a recognition accuracy of 96.3% in different scenes, effectively distinguishing between indoor and outdoor environments. Moreover, compared to traditional recognition algorithms such as SVM, KNN, and PNN, the proposed method shows an improvement of 2%-5% in accuracy.

articleTitle: Summarizing Videos using the Uniqueness of Video Frames that Mask Adjacent Frame Information
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: Video summarization can help people retrieve videos quickly. Existing unsupervised video summarization models make insufficient use of video frame uniqueness in the self-attention mechanism and have redundancy in the computation of uniqueness. In this paper, we rethink the relationship between attentive uniqueness and diversity of video frames, improve the calculation method of video frame uniqueness by masking adjacent frame information in the model framework based on a self-attention mechanism, and simplify the concentrated attention mechanism with it. In addition, we propose a new loss function called Deviation loss, which uses the uniqueness of video frames to calculate and helps train video summarization models to obtain diverse representations. The experimental results show that the proposed method outperforms other state-of-the-art unsupervised summarization approaches on the SumMe dataset, and also demonstrates competitiveness on the TVSum dataset.

articleTitle: Military-Related Rumour Detection Based on Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: In response to the problem that military-related rumor detection is neglected in online rumour detection, which affects the online ecology and also brings challenges to the image of the army and the psychology of officers and soldiers, we analyze the characteristics of military-related rumours and their linguistic features, and try to apply Bi-directional long short term memory (Bi-LSTM) and attention mechanism, We propose a military-related rumour detection model based on Bi-LSTM + Attention mechanism. The model is based on the model comparison of public datasets, and the military-related datasets established to complete the experimental tests, and the results found that its accuracy rate reached 97.8%, which has a better detection effect.

articleTitle: Analysis of Emotional Changes in Twitter Users by Personality Type Before and After the Outbreak of the COVID-19 Pandemic
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: Three years have passed since the outbreak of the novel coronavirus pandemic at the end of 2019, and the situation continues to change daily as non-pharmaceutical interventions and associated restrictions are gradually being eased. Even now, drastic changes in aspects of daily living continue to have significant impacts in terms of physical and mental stress on many people. In this study, we analyzed changes in Twitter users’ comments, thoughts, and actions by conducting sentiment analysis of the content of tweets posted before and after the outbreak of the pandemic. We extracted characteristic expressions and conducted a comparative analysis. In addition, we examined changes in emotions according to users’ personality types.

articleTitle: Variable Frequency Speed Regulation System of Three-level High-power Asynchronous Motor Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: In order to improve the application efficiency of high-power frequency conversion device and simplify the control process of soft start and soft stop of asynchronous motor under high power condition, this paper adopts NPC(neutral point clamped three-level inverter as the main circuit, FPGA as the control chip, and adopts digital space vector pulse width modulation (SVPWM), which improves the voltage utilization ratio, reduces the harmonic of current and makes the system have good start-stop characteristics.

articleTitle: A Convolutional Computing Design Using Pulsating Arrays
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: The training and reasoning of convolutional neural networks (CNN) require a large amount of computation, among which the most core operation is convolutional operation. In order to accelerate convolutional operation, many methods for accelerating convolution have emerged in recent years, including sliding window method, Winograd algorithm, etc. Although the sliding window method and Winograd algorithm can improve the computational efficiency of convolution to a certain extent, they also have some drawbacks. The sliding window method requires a large amount of data reuse and transmission, thus requiring high bandwidth and low latency memory and data paths, which is also the main challenge of its hardware implementation; The Winograd algorithm requires preprocessing of convolutional kernels and input data, which increases the computational and storage burden in the early stage. At the same time, for convolutional kernels of different sizes, matrix transformations need to be regenerated, which increases the difficulty of algorithm implementation. Based on this, this article adopts a pulsating array convolution calculation method based on fixed weights.

articleTitle: Optimized Coding Methods of the Rectangular Non-Symmetry and Anti-packing Model for Gray Images
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: Inspired by the idea of rectangular optimized coding scheme for binary images, this paper proposes three optimized coding methods aimed at gray image compression using the rectangular non-symmetry and anti-packing model (RNAMC). The adaptive arithmetic encoding and the adjacent position correlation encoding based on column bisections are used to improve representation efficiency of gray images. The experimental results show the effectiveness of the three optimized coding methods proposed in this paper. These methods can improve the compression ratio in the RNAMC algorithm and have a good application prospect in some commercial applications related to image processing, such as reducing storage space, increasing processing speed, and improving pattern matching efficiency.

Author Keywords: adjacent position correlation encoding based on column bisections

articleTitle: A new low-profile combined antenna based on magnetoelectric dipole
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: In this paper, a broadband antenna design method based on the characteristics of magnetoelectric dipole is proposed to realize dual-band operation in two smaller broadband ranges of 3.2-4.2 GHz and 4.6-5.6 GHz by using its stable radiation directional map and symmetry combined with dielectric loading technique, magnetoelectric dipole folding and liquid medium selection. The design scheme takes full advantage of the stable radiation directional map and symmetry of the magnetoelectric dipole. The performance of the antenna is further enhanced by the application of dielectric loading technique. Through the folding of the magnetoelectric dipole, the antenna profile is effectively reduced and a compact design is achieved. In addition, the broadband operation of this antenna in the stated frequency band range is successfully achieved by the reasonable choice of liquid medium. Compared with other magnetoelectric dipole antennas and conventional broadband antennas, this antenna has many advantages that cannot be obtained by a single antenna. It has dual-band broadband capability, small size, low profile and simple structure, which can effectively meet the future demand of large data capacity and provide a reliable and efficient solution for the development of communication systems. This research work provides an innovative approach in the field of broadband antenna design, which breaks through the existing limitations through advanced technology and opens a new path for the development of next generation wireless communication technology.

articleTitle: Research on Small Target Detection Algorithm Based on Improved YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: Accompanied by nowadays rapid development of artificial intelligence, scientific computing equipment and the upgrading of portable camera equipment, the detection of large and medium targets in videos and images can no longer satisfied the needs of people’s real life, and small target detection has become a fiery-hot spot in the range of target detection research problem. Aiming at the problems of missed detection and low precision caused by factors such as few effective features and low resolution of small targets in the picture, this paper proposes a small object detection algorithm based on improved YOLOv5(You Only Look Once). First of all, in order to solve the problems of missed detection and false detection in small target detection, the SE(Squeeze-Excitation) attention mechanism is integrated into the backbone network to improve the performance of the model. Secondly, in order to solve the unknown geometric transformation problem of the same object in different scenes and different angles, the DCNv2(Deformab1e ConvNets v2) model is added to expand the receptive field and improve the robustness of target detection. The experimental results show that the average detection accuracy (mAP) of the improved YOLOv5s model on the VisDrone dataset has reached 37.56%, which is 5.37% higher than that of YOLOv5s and can effectively detect small targets.

articleTitle: Multi-attribute Decision Making Based on Interval Pythagorean Fuzzy Einstein Operator
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: Aiming at the multi-attribute decision problem of Pythagorean information with interrelated attribute information with interval value, a multi-attribute decision method based on Pythagorean fuzzy Einstein ensemble algorithm is constructed by combining the Einstein operator. Firstly, considering that the decision information is an interval value Pythagorean fuzzy number with a certain intrinsic relationship between attributes and the algorithm of Pythagorean fuzzy numbers, the interval value Pythagorean fuzzy Einstein weighted average (IVPFEWA) operator is proposed, and then its correlation properties are analyzed and proved. Secondly, in view of the fact that the scoring function does not reflect the hesitation of the decision-maker in decision-making, A scoring function is introduced that takes full account of decision maker hesitancy, and the comprehensive profit and loss value of each scheme is obtained by using the prospect theory, and the optimal scheme is obtained according to the comparison of the comprehensive profit and loss value. Finally, a multi-attribute decision model based on IVPFEWA operator is established, and the rationality and effectiveness of the decision model are proposed through 5G enterprise selection cases.

articleTitle: Chord Generation Based on Transformer and Color Harmony Theory
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: Artificial intelligence has been widely used in the field of music and achieved good results. As an important concept in music, chord generation is one of the basic tasks in composition. The application of machine learning in music is of great significance to human’s understanding of artificial intelligence and music, and artificial intelligence technology can also enrich people’s research in music. In this paper, a chord generation model is constructed based on Transformer to further dig into the internal structure of chords and consider chords from the aspect of chord notes, hoping to generate more delicate and flexible chords. At the same time, combined with the color harmony theory, the evaluation method and mapping method meeting the rules of music theory are constructed, hoping to get better output effect through a simple model, and the template mapping method is used to improve the actual effect and extensibility of the model.

articleTitle: Cooperative Delivery of Truck-UAV with Consideration of the UAV Track
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: There is a problem that it is difficult to solve the dual planning of Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) track and delivery path in the cooperative truck-UAV logistics delivery mode. Therefore, the multi-constraint mixed integer programming models of track planning and cooperative delivery path planning were constructed respectively, and A* algorithm and adaptive large-scale domain search algorithm were used to solve the track planning and path planning models respectively. Firstly, the simulation environment of UAV flight track planning is constructed by using digital elevation data, and the multi-objective flight track planning function is solved by A* algorithm to get the results. Then, the output results of UAV three-dimensional flight track planning, such as distance and energy consumption, were input into the integrated collaborative delivery mode as parameters to provide decision support for the solution process and obtain better solutions. The simulation results show that in the collaborative delivery mode, the navigation distance data obtained by using the three-dimensional flight track planning of UAV is closer to the actual application scene than the traditional Euclidean distance, which increases the practical application value of this mode. The hybrid algorithm can solve the track planning and path planning efficiently and accurately, and has good convergence performance.

articleTitle: Two-dimensional Kapur Entropy Multilevel Thresholding Algorithm Based on Dynamic Programming and Spatial Contextual Information
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: The Kapur entropy multilevel thresholding image segmentation algorithm based on the two-dimensional histogram does not consider the spatial contextual information of image pixels, and the algorithm’s time complexity increases exponentially with the increase of the number of thresholds. To address the above problems, this paper proposes a 2D-Kapur entropy multilevel thresholding image segmentation algorithm based on an energy curve by using both the neighborhood information and spatial contextual information of pixels. To improve the computational efficiency of the multilevel thresholding segmentation algorithm, a dynamic programming computational framework of the 2D-Kapur entropy multilevel thresholding algorithm based on the energy curve is constructed. The performance of the proposed algorithm is compared with several different image thresholding algorithms on the noise and complex images using several evaluation indexes. The experimental results verify the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Deep learning knowledge tracing based on behavioral features
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: Knowledge tracing assesses students’ understanding of knowledge concepts and learning progress by tracking their learning behaviors and performance in answering questions. Research has shown that existing deep learning-based knowledge tracing models only consider the training and outcomes of students as inputs, ignoring the rich behavioral information generated by students during the learning process. This information can provide a clearer understanding of students’ mastery of the knowledge points. In this study, a deep learning knowledge tracing model based on a dynamic key-value memory network model with strong interpretability is selected as the foundation. The XGBoost decision tree algorithm is used to preprocess the student’s behavioral information, capturing the impact of student behavioral factors on their cognitive states, and integrating the classification results with the learning features. Experimental results demonstrate that the improved deep learning knowledge tracing model outperforms traditional deep learning knowledge tracing models in terms of predictive accuracy on educational datasets.

articleTitle: Research on UAV Small Target Detection Algorithm Based on Improved YOLOv5s
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: A UAV small target detection algorithm based on improved YOLOv5s is proposed to address the problems of missed detection and low accuracy in UAV aerial photography. Firstly, to solve the problem of missed detection in small target detection, the GAM attention mechanism is added to the backbone network to expand the detection range and improve the detection capability. Secondly, to solve the problem of easy semantic loss in small target detection, CAM module is added, which can effectively enrich the semantic information. The experimental results show that the average detection accuracy (mAP) of this algorithm reaches 37.88% on the VisDrone2019-DET dataset, which is 5.35% better than YOLOv5s.

articleTitle: Doctor recommendations based on the ERNIE model
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: In order to recommend appropriate departments and doctors to patients, this paper uses the ERNIE pre-trained language learning model to classify corresponding departments for patient’s disease descriptions, then calculates the similarity between patient’s disease descriptions and doctors’ expertise, so as to show patients the ranking of doctors in corresponding departments for patients to choose consultation. As is shown in the experimental results on Haodf.com datasets, the ERNIE model outperforms other models in terms of evaluation indexes, and the accuracy rate is improved by 3.54%-11.51%.

articleTitle: Establishment and Research of a Janus SbBiSi2 Monolayer Structure Model
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: By means of density functional theory (DFT) compute, we set up a fresh two-dimensional(2D) Janus $SbBiSi_{2}$ monolayer. The $SbBiSi_{2}$ monolayer has piezoelectric properties on account of the lack of inversion symmetry. The stability of the material is proved from the aspects of dynamics, thermodynamic and mechanics, and it has the possibility of synthesis in experiment. The band structutre indicates that the monolayer $SbBiSi_{2}$ is an indirect bandgap semiconductor. The energygaps is 0.91 eV when using generalized gradient approximation(GGA), and decreases to 0.51 eV when spin-orbit coupling(SOC) is added. Further, we explored the influence of strain regulation on the electronic structure and piezoelectric properties of $2DSbBiSi_{2}$ monolayer. When the biaxial strain Within the scope of (-0.06, 0.06) is applied to the $SbBiSi_{2}$ monolayer, the in-plane and out-of-plane piezoelectric coefficient $d_{11}$ and $d_{31}$ both reach the maximum value at 1.04 tensile strain, indicating that strain regulation has an enhanced effect on the piezoelectric properties. The piezoelectric properties of Janus monolayer $SbBiSi_{2}$ have great application prospects in 2D Piezoelectric materials have great application prospects in nanoscale devices such as active sensors and actuators.

Author Keywords: two-dimensional piezoelectric materials two-dimensional Janus materials

articleTitle: Semi-Physical Interface Delay Compensation Method for Smart Grid Simulation
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: With the increasing integration of communication and information technology in smart grid system, research on semi-physical co-simulation techniques for power grid and communication information system is becoming increasingly popular. However, the current focus of co-simulation research remains on enabling the co-simulation itself, often neglecting the time delay introduced by the semi-physical interaction interface. This can lead to a decrease in the authenticity and credibility of the simulation results. This paper proposes a delay compensation method for semi-physical interface based on QualNet. Test results show that, on the basis of controlling external environmental variables, power devices using this delay compensation method are closer to real-world situations, and the simulation accuracy can reach millisecond level. Therefore, this delay compensation method has good compensation effects and to some extent solves the impact of the uncertain running state of the simulation server on simulation accuracy.

articleTitle: Design of A FFT Processor Based on The Variable Mixed-radix Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: FFT processors are widely used in digital signal processing, but they cause a lot of hardware consumption when computing large point sequences. This paper introduces a high-performance, low-complexity, and the configurable number of points FFT processors. At the algorithm level, a Variable Mixed-radix algorithm is proposed to reduce the computation of complex multiplication by 10-20% and improve the throughput rate by sequence advance splitting method; at the hardware level, a parallel iterative architecture and array processing architecture are combined to enhance the processor operation efficiency by RAM reconfiguration method. After experimental verification and analysis, it is concluded that the design finally supports 1k-32k points sequence FFT computation. The computation speed at processing 32k points is improved by 11.14% compared with the same processor type.

articleTitle: DyHead-YOLOv5 Based on Improved Object Detection Heads with Attentions
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: A survey of object detection algorithms has revealed that the low accuracy of most lightweight object detection algorithms,More and more people are working on various algorithms. In this paper, the model training is carried out by improving the YOLOv5 object detection algorithm, adding a Dynamic Head framework based on attention mechanism to the original Head layer, modifying the default normalization method Group Normalization (GN) to Batch Normalizatio (BN) in the original framework, and then conducting experimental research on the VisDrone datasets and VOC2012 datasets. The results show that compared with the YOLOv5s model, key indicators such as mean of Average Precision (mAP)@0.5 and mAP@0.5:0.95 are improved, which can achieve better recognition effect on the dataset without significantly increasing the complexity of the model.

articleTitle: Design of F-L-QC-LDPC Decoder Based on LNMS Decoding Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: Low Density Parity Check Code (LDPC) can meet the decoding requirements of a variety of code lengths and rates in different communication scenarios, but the LDPC code check matrix is irregular, which has problems with difficult storage and reading of the check matrix and high coding complexity. For the decoding requirements of multi-code length, this paper proposes a Quasi Crystal Low Density Parity Check Codes (QCLDPC) code based on Fibonacci Lucas sequence, which can obtain the codewords with different code length and code rate by changing the number of rows and columns of the exponential matrix. In terms of decoding algorithms, the Layered Non-Maximum Suppression (LNMS) decoding algorithm, which combines the minimum sum decoding algorithm with the layered algorithm, is proposed to improve the convergence speed of decoding iteration and decoder throughput. Through simulation and comparative experiments, it is proved that this design can support a variety of bit rates, block lengths and sub matrix sizes, and meet the requirements of high throughput and low complexity decoder in modern communication systems.

articleTitle: Social distance calculation based on improved Yolov7
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: In daily life, maintaining proper social distance can effectively stop the spread of epidemic viruses and help protect our lives and property. In this study, we developed a social distance detection system designed by a promoted yolov7 deep neural network, and ensured that the system distance error is fully applicable to daily pedestrian distance detection. Based on the faster and more accurate yolov7 framework, we first use a self-made specific dataset for data augmentation, then use k-means++ to design a pre-selected box that fits the pedestrian size, finally, use the SIOU loss function to replace CIOU to obtain faster convergence speed and optimization effect. The experimental results show that the detection speed of the network is 106 FPS and the accuracy value is 93.1%, which is 0.9% better than the original algorithm and achieves the effect of real-time pedestrian distance detection. Studying the imaging principle of monocular camera, we use Zhang’s calibration method to obtain the internal reference and aberration parameters of the camera, then use the algorithm of inverse perspective change to transform the region of interest into the viewpoint of the bird’s eye view, applying the scale factor in the viewpoint of the bird’s eye view can be converted into the specific distance of pedestrians in the actual three-dimensional space. The experiment was conducted in the entrance of the liberal arts building, and the calculated error was kept within 20mm, which ensured the availability of safe social distance.

articleTitle: Application of RPA-AI technology in enterprise financial intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: Looking back on the development course of financial management, every change is inseparable from technological innovation. Accounting computerization replaces part of manual accounting work with small database and simple computer software and realizes the leap of computing power and storage ability. The birth of ERP and the popularization of computer network have centralized closed and dispersed finance, and realized financial sharing through process reengineering and professional division of labor. The appearance of RPA robot replaces the manual handling of complex, highly repetitive and large number of tedious affairs, thus reducing the cost of human resources and improving work efficiency. The combination of RPA and AI will further innovate financial technology tools and quietly change the working mode of finance.

articleTitle: CRNet: Combining CenterNet and R-CNN for Object Detection in Traffic Scenes
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: Object detection is typically formulated by researchers as a bounding box regression task(the two-stage method) or an object center localization task (the one-stage method). However, the methods incorporating the above two ideas make inferior performance in terms of both inference speed and detection accuracy, with quite limited applications in real-world traffic scenes. In this paper, we propose a simple but effective method named Center-RCNN(CRNet) which incorporates the aforementioned two ideas. Specifically, we first adopt the methods of object center localization instead of typical region proposal network(RPN) to conduct proposal selection in a fast and simple way, and then use the bounding box regression method to predict the final object location. The whole network combines the advantages of the two methods to keep a balance between inference accuracy and speed. Experiments are conducted on the BDD100K dataset, and the results prove the effectiveness of our method.

articleTitle: Multi-Cycle Emergency Material Dispatch Considering the Impact of Psychological Anxiety Under Public Health Emergencies
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: In this paper, we establish a quantitative function to describe the psychological anxiety of people during the COVID19 outbreak. It considers the impact of the shortage rate of emergency supplies, the dynamic number of new confirmed cases and the sensitivity of emergency supplies. On this basis, a multicycle multi-objective emergency supplies dispatching model is constructed with the objective of minimizing logistics costs and psychological anxiety costs. Then the model is solved using a fast non-dominated ranking genetic algorithm. Finally, numerical experiments were conducted using the COVID-19 outbreak in Hubei Province in 2020 as a case study. The results show that the proposed model and algorithm can effectively solve the multicycle emergency supplies distribution problem when considering the psychological anxiety in an epidemic environment. Compared with the basic emergency supplies dispatching model, results show that the proposed model can effectively reduce 60.50% psychological anxiety cost only with 8.66% increase in logistics cost. Further sensitivity analysis show that the psychological anxiety cost increased by 67.27% when reducing one unit of emergency supplies. The findings of this paper will help emergency management departments to better develop emergency supplies dispatch plans during public health emergencies.

articleTitle: Improved PAPR Reduction Algorithm for OTFS Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: One of the main problems of Orthogonal Time Frequency Space (OTFS) modulation is its Peak-to-Average Power Ratio (PAPR), which can cause signal distortion and deteriorate the overall system bit error rate (BER). The conventional Selective Mapping (SLM) algorithm has a very high computation complexity due to too many Heisenberg transforms required for signal branches, a Selective Mapping method of the normalized grouping (NSLM) was proposed to reduce the PAPR of OTFS system. By the linear combination of a half of signal branches, more candidate signal sets were generated. At the same time, the power normalization kept the original peak value unchanged. The μ-NSLM was then proposed by combining the NSLM with the μ-LAW companding algorithm, which further reduces the PAPR of the system. Simulation results show that the μ-NSLM algorithm outperforms the conventional SLM methods in PAPR reduction. When the Complementary Cumulative Distribution Function (CCDF) is about 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup>, the branch number Q=16, compared with the original signal, the conventional SLM algorithm and the NSLM algorithm, the proposed the μ-NSLM algorithm reduced the PAPR by 4.83dB, 1.67dB and 0.96dB respectively, achieving a significant improvement in PAPR reduction.

articleTitle: Spiking Neural Network Classification Method in Motor Imagery Brain-Computer Interface
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: Electroencephalogram (EEG) Brain-computer interface (BCI) classification research has become a hot field recently. This paper proposes spiking neural network (SNN) classification method of motor imagery EEG signals. Firstly, the raw EEG signal is preprocessed by band-pass filtering, and encoded into spike signals by Ben’s Spike encoding algorithm. Then, convolution layers and pooling layer is designed in SNN to take advantage of the characteristics of EEG signal. Finally, the SNN is employed to classify the spike signals. It is worth noting that the activation function in SNN is different from the convolutional neural network. It simulates biological encode information of brain in the form of spikes by the LIF model. By simulating the change process of membrane potential, it realizes the transmission of intercellular spikes and the active release of membrane potential without input, which makes the signal processing closer to the neuron cell membrane potential processing mechanism. On the other hand, since spike signals can weaken the negative effect of noise in the superposition process, spikes input can reduce the influence of noise in the network. The BCI Competition IV 2a datasets are used in the experiments, and the classification results show that the proposed classification method achieves the average classification accuracy of 82.08%.

articleTitle: An Artificial Intelligence-Based Approach for Classification of Personal Color
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: The classification of personal color plays a vital role in various industries, particularly in fashion and cosmetics, where personalized recommendations and customized experiences hold great significance. In this paper, we present an approach to standardize the process of personal color diagnosis, which has historically varied due to the subjectivity of individual consultants. Our approach utilizes artificial intelligence (AI) classification models, such as support vector machine (SVM) and multilayer perceptron (MLP), in conjunction with a high performance face detection model.Furthermore, the study delves into the practical applications of the AI-based personal color classification approach, particularly its potential to facilitate personalized recommendations in the fashion industry. It can also aid in the selection of makeup products based on individual facial color palettes, enhancing the overall personalized experience for consumers.In conclusion, this study presents an innovative and accurate AI-based approach for classifying personal color. The proposed model demonstrates promising results in categorizing individuals into distinct color categories, thereby opening up new avenues for personalized experiences across multiple industries. The integration of AI technology in personal color classification has the potential to revolutionize the way we perceive and engage with color, leading to enhanced customization and satisfaction in various aspects of our daily lives.

articleTitle: Optimisation of Takeaway Delivery Routes Considering Order Combination
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: It has been a hot topic in the takeaway industry that how to reduce total delivery costs while considering users’ satisfaction. Considering the traditional takeaway delivery pattern, due to the influence of partial merchant locations, some orders are assigned to different riders for delivery, so that the routes delivered by different riders have the same repetitive sections, resulting in an increase in delivery costs. In order to solve this problem, with considering the satisfaction of merchants and customers, this paper proposes the idea of rider handover and order combination for delivery, then a mathematical model with riding distance cost and time penalty cost as the optimization objectives is established. By improving the genetic algorithm to solve the arithmetic example, the feasibility and effectiveness of the model and algorithm are verified. The results show that delivery with rider handover and order combination can effectively reduce delivery costs, which provides a feasible reference for takeaway delivery management and prepares the foundation for further research.

articleTitle: Construction of Knowledge Graph of Neurodegenerative Diseases Based on Ontology
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: Neurodegenerative diseases are common in the elderly population, and the early symptoms of the disease are often not obvious and have a long course. Early detection, diagnosis and treatment of the disease are important to slow down the disease progression. In this study, clinical guidelines and medical textbooks are used as knowledge sources to construct an ontology of neurodegenerative diseases, which contains 10 types of concepts, 17 object attributes and 7 data attributes. The knowledge Graph of neurodegenerative diseases was constructed based on the ontology. The data sources of the knowledge Graph are clinical guidelines, medical textbooks, and medical websites. The knowledge triad was obtained by knowledge extraction and knowledge fusion, and stored in Neo4j. The constructed knowledge graph of neurodegenerative diseases finally contains 2012 disease-related entities.

articleTitle: Hesitant Fuzzy Sublattices of Lattices
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: In this paper, sublattices problem of lattices is studied by using the method and principle of hesitant fuzzy sets. The concept of hesitant fuzzy sublattices of lattices is introduced and its properties are investigated. The relationship between hesitant fuzzy sublattices and sublattices is given. It is proved that hesitant fuzzy intersection and direct product of some hesitant fuzzy sublattices, homomorphism image and inverse image of a hesitant fuzzy sublattice are also hesitant fuzzy sublattice. At the same time, a condition which makes hesitant fuzzy union of some hesitant fuzzy sublattices to be a hesitant fuzzy sublattice is obtained.

articleTitle: A Synergistic Operation And Maintenance Service Method Of Complex Products Based On Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: Operation and maintenance (O&M) service plays an important role in ensuring continuous production and improving products utilization, especially for complex products (CPs) working in various conditions and harsh environments. However, the O&M service of CPs are facing many challenges due to the maintenance resources and the stakeholders included in the whole O&M service stage are dispersed and independent. One important challenge is how to accurately extract and efficiently organize and reuse the O&M service knowledge to improve the accuracy of maintenance activities. To address this challenge, a knowledge graph (KG) based synergistic O&M service method for CPs is proposed. The knowledge extraction and ontology modeling technologies were used to establish the multi-player synergistic O&M service KG. As a result, the efficient query of service providers, the visualization of O&M knowledge and the synergy of different maintenance activities can be achieved.

articleTitle: An improved Sparrow search path planning algorithm for UAV
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: In order to address the problems of easily sink into local optima and insufficient convergence when solving the SSA, this paper proposes an improved sparrow search path planning algorithm for UAV. First, the periodic adaptive convergence factor is introduced, improves the rate of convergence of the algorithm, and solves the problem that the algorithm is easy to fall into local optimization. Secondly, a dynamic adjustment strategy for the number of discoverers was introduced to address transitioning algorithms from global exploration to local exploration.Then, an adaptive spiral search strategy was introduced to enable the improved follower position update formula to fully utilize the information of the optimal individual and conduct spiral searches around the optimal individual. Finally, compared and simulated with the original algorithm and PSO algorithm in different environments, The improved algorithm has a shorter path and better search ability.

articleTitle: A Tool for Printed Circuit Board Defect Detection based on the YOLO Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: Printed circuit board (PCB) is an essential component of modern machines. To solve the problems of a wide variety of PCB defects with complex shapes, small defect regions, and difficulties in accurately locating defects, a tool for PCB defect detection based on the You Only Look Once (YOLO) algorithm is implemented. Six types of PCB defects, i.e., Missing-hole, Mouse-bite, Open-circuit, Short, Spur, and Spurious-copper, can be detected through the designed tool. The attention mechanism and multi-scale feature fusion structure are introduced to the original YOLOv5s algorithm to decrease the missed detection rate of small defects and improve the detection speed. An intelligent defect detection system is then designed and implemented to meet the real-time detection requirements in actual PCB production scenario. The experimental results show that the detection accuracy and F1 score of the improved YOLOv5s system reach 97.4% and 0.97, respectively.

articleTitle: Effects of Contrast on the Anticipatory Dynamics of a Retina
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: The retinal network is a natural computational system with the ability to perform multiple tasks concurrently, including generating anticipatory responses to predictable stimuli. To study the effects of signal contrast on retinal anticipatory responses, experiments are conducted on bullfrog retinas using a multi-electrode array (MEA) system. The method of time lag mutual information (TLMI) between the retinal responses and the stimulation is used to assess the retina’s anticipatory capabilities. Results indicate that higher contrast stimulation generally yields better anticipation and higher information transfer. However, some channels only exhibit anticipatory behavior when the contrast is sufficiently high. This finding implies that performing anticipatory tasks, such as playing badminton, may be more challenging in low-contrast visual environments. The observation of the Weber-Fechner law through TLMI suggests that the amount of information transferred could serve as a measure of our visual perception (sensation) of the external physical world.

articleTitle: Research on State Data Mining Technology of Primary and Distribution Collaborative Grid Based on Low Code Credibility
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: With the development of the company’s energy Internet and power grid digital transformation construction work, the company’s large-scale data mining work has become an important way to highlight the value of data. How to quickly, safely and effectively extract valuable information from complicated data has become the focus of current research. The mainstream low-code development technology can solve the problems of rapid development of data applications and untimely iteration of application modules, and meet the needs of large-scale application of data mining. However, in actual applications, there are problems such as data security risks and collaborative computing privacy leaks. Therefore, breakthroughs in low-code The credible research and development technology of power data mining is imminent. In response to the above problems, this paper proposes a secure sharing and retrieval technology based on multi-source heterogeneous power data and a cross-professional privacy protection and trusted computing technology driven by power services, and develops a low-code data security application and trusted development platform to “embed”, “style” approach, which provides an in-depth data linkage mechanism that covers the entire display elements and can be cross-page and cross-system. It effectively improves the data security of the enterprise, and at the same time improves the ability of business personnel to apply data, supporting the efficient and rapid development of electric power enterprises.

articleTitle: A Deadline Constrained Scheduling Algorithm for Cloud Computing System based on the Timing Strategy
publicationTitle: 2023 19th International Conference on Natural Computation, Fuzzy Systems and Knowledge Discovery (ICNC-FSKD)
abstract: For the workflow scheduling question with delivery time constraints in cloud computing environments, a time-aware scheduling-driven cloud computing scheduling algorithm is proposed. This algorithm considers the impact of the workflow task path length on the overall workflow delivery time and introduces a sub-deadline allocation strategy. Additionally, a time-aware scheduling strategy is presented to address the cost reduction challenge of workflow execution under the pricing policies of cloud services.
